title: Validate sales order source lineage during ordinary form save
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add Application source-lineage rules invoked by ordinary sales-order create/update/submit/approve. For explicit PI/quotation IDs resolve exact nondeleted source, live enabled existing source and sales-order menu authority, current customer scope and existing conversion eligibility; normalize authoritative source numbers and PI quotation ancestry, reject conflicting source pair/foreign customer/invalid source. Never infer source from number or require arbitrary price equality beyond established conversion rules; unlinked manual orders remain valid. Preserve existing amounts/currency/unit and server detail calculations.

Transaction and deterministic source-to-order lock sequence compatible with ERP399/400 conversions, recheck duplicate target and persisted source/order state before number reservation/save. Race manual prefill save versus direct conversion or source invalidation must produce legal consistent source/target history and at most one target under existing duplicate rule. No silent clearing/rebinding of historical source; explicit editable link changes require complete live revalidation and downstream freeze. Real SQL forged/foreign/revoked/disabled/invalid-source and two independent connections manual/direct conversion, source cancel/save, competing manual saves, edit/approve, rollback; meaningful unit and existing sales-order/conversion regressions, safe Release and browser evidence or accurate blocker.

implementation_evidence: SalesOrderController.Create generates number then persists caller SourcePiId/SourceQuotationId without authoritative source resolution; Update copies both IDs and source numbers. Specialized PI/quotation conversion protects only direct conversion actions, so editable prefill and forged ordinary saves can bypass source eligibility/duplicate guards.
